A sandbox world made by nimitz 0.4.0 (main 66f88bc): `nimitz sandbox create`,
then `start MAIN/ARGOS/STOPPED --yes`, `start MAIN --yes`, `check MAIN`,
`ship new MAIN/ARGOS/LATE --dir managed --prompt hi --yes`, all by the 0.4.0
binary. The world's own path is `@@BASE@@`: a test copies the tree and puts
its own path there.
